title: Combating Label Sparsity in Short Text Topic Modeling via Nearest Neighbor Augmentation
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2024
subcategory: kNN label completion for neural short-text topic models
problem: Short documents miss semantically relevant words, so the reconstruction target is incomplete (label sparsity) and the ELBO is biased.
architecture: kNNTM: VAE-based neural topic model whose reconstruction target is augmented with words from the k nearest documents; neighbours found with a fused multi-view distance combining optimal-transport word-level similarity and global topic semantics.
key_results: Snippet K = 50: TQ 0.365 vs TSCTM 0.346; top-NMI 0.427 vs 0.381.
GoogleNews K = 100: top-Purity 0.786 and top-NMI 0.868 vs TSCTM 0.766 and 0.842.
MCTM has the highest CV in most settings but much lower TU (e.g. 0.556 on GoogleNews K = 50).
strengths: Identifies and addresses the label-sparsity problem; strong clustering gains.

limitations.text: Optimal-transport distances between all document pairs are costly for very large datasets.
Topic coherence gains are small; on StackOverflow K = 100, CV is below several baselines (0.264).
